title: Backward-facing step — Driver & Seegmiller straight-wall experiment

reference.citation: Driver & Seegmiller (1985), AIAA Journal 23, 163-171; AGARD-AR-345 data sheet CMP32
reference.data_policy: Use the original CMP32 machine-readable time-averaged data file where available. Freeze source, units, stations, coordinates and SHA-256. Do not digitize figures as a substitute.

secondary_sources.citation: Morsbach (2017), Reynolds Stress Modelling for Turbomachinery Flow Applications, Table 5.2
NASA comparison report, Driver–Seegmiller reattachment length 6.25

geometry.opposite_wall: Straight and parallel; exclude the divergent 6-degree configuration.

flow.comparison_caveat: NASA TMR computational surrogate often specifies nominal Re_h=36000; this frozen experiment contract declares Re_h=37500. They are distinct flow states and must not be cross-compared without re-normalization.

primary: reattachment location x_r/h from zero crossing of measured wall shear stress
U1/Uref and U2/Uref profiles at all published stations
wall shear stress and pressure recovery
qoi.reattachment_definition: Interpolate the first downstream zero crossing of tau_w(x) from negative to positive; also report the zero crossing of Cf. Do not infer x_r visually from a velocity contour.

reference_targets.reattachment_source: Driver–Seegmiller value compiled in Morsbach (2017) and NASA backward-step comparison report; use CMP32 wall-shear profile as primary zero-crossing oracle.

boundary_conditions.inlet: Measured turbulent boundary-layer profile at x=-4h; prescribe measured turbulence quantities or document a reproducible reconstruction and quantify its uncertainty. A uniform inlet is not acceptable.
boundary_conditions.walls: No-slip; reproduce straight upper wall and test-section dimensions.
boundary_conditions.outlet: Long straight recovery duct; outlet sensitivity must be checked.

models.comparison: realizable k-epsilon with a wall treatment consistent with its formulation
models.unsteady: URANS/LES only if unsteady quantities are added; original CMP32 target is time-averaged.

verification.mesh: Three levels; refine inlet boundary layer, step corner, separated shear layer, reattachment region and downstream recovery. Report y+ and non-orthogonality.
gates: inlet boundary-layer profile match before step
velocity and Reynolds-stress profile errors normalized by measurement uncertainty

status.reason: Experimental production SST momentum transport exists, but the measured CMP32 inlet, three real converged meshes and independent reattachment/Cp/Cf evidence are still missing. The Armaly/Re=200 benchmark is not a substitute.
